description: This file defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes for decoding CBOR maps in the context of the Zephyr project, specifically related to the mcumgr utility. It includes mechanisms for mapping keys to decoders, decoding bulk maps, and managing decoding state.

methods.name: zcbor_map_decode_bulk
methods.description: Decodes a bulk CBOR map according to a provided key-decoder mapping, returning status codes based on success or specific errors.

methods.name: zcbor_map_decode_bulk_key_found
methods.description: Checks if a specific key was found during the decoding process.

methods.name: zcbor_map_decode_bulk_reset
methods.description: Resets the internal decoding state of a key-value map to allow re-decoding.
